messages:
mobile-cust: Hey, mid-stream disconnects when a user hops from cellular to their phone hotspot. We get a partial JSON chunk and then `stream closed` after ~8s. Request id: r-9b2f. Billing shows full tokens charged though.
cleo-cs: Thanks — can you paste the raw request headers and confirm if you're using SSE or websocket? Also which SDK version?
alice-support: @cleo-cs tagging for priority. mobile-cust, do you see any network errors on the device (Android/iOS)?
mobile-cust: Android 13, using our in-app SSE client (custom). Logs show `java.net.SocketException: Socket closed` right after mobile switches to hotspot. Repro: enable hotspot on test phone and stream a long generation. Client logs: 
```
[15:12:08] CONNECT -> SSE open
[15:12:16] RECEIVED: {"partial": "..."}
[15:12:24] NETWORK: WIFI -> HOTSPOT
[15:12:25] ERROR java.net.SocketException: Socket closed
[15:12:25] STREAM: closed by client
```
No other app errors.
alice-support: Ok; two linked things we've seen: (1) mobile handoff kills the TCP socket (expected), (2) our token refresh or keepalive race can make the server finalize the stream immediately. Devon, anything on server heuristics that finalize on abrupt disconnects?
devon-sre: yep — runtime flushes & finalizes when TCP goes away. We don't have resumable SSE for generation sessions yet, so the work done server-side can still count toward tokens. Mitigations we've recommended: 
- shorten server-side inactivity timeout (route-level, configurable)
- client heartbeat/ping every 10–15s to keep sockets alive during flaky handoffs
- avoid rotating auth mid-stream (prefetch token at request start)
Also set `Connection: keep-alive` and send a light app ping over the SSE channel.
cleo-cs: @mobile-cust can you repro with the SDK `sse-heartbeat` flag enabled and paste the `x-request-id` from the server response?
mobile-cust: With `sse-heartbeat=true` failures dropped from 100% -> ~20%. `x-request-id` for the failing run: r-9b2f-iso. Noticed our token refresh at t+20s lined up with the hotspot flip and likely caused the race.
alice-support: Short-term workaround: delay token refresh until stream idle or do a refresh window pre-request. We can also apply a per-account route tweak to extend drain time (keep server-side generation open longer to allow client reconnect).
devon-sre: Filed INF-3421 to track resumable/resume semantics. We'll also add a docs entry with recommended client configs. For now, recommend: heartbeat 10–15s, no mid-stream auth rotation, and enable `Connection: keep-alive`.
cleo-cs: I'll send the customer step-by-step: enable heartbeat, avoid mid-stream token rotate, and offer the extended drain config as an account setting. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident INF-3421 created by devon-sre. Priority: P2.
mobile-cust: Thanks all — heartbeat + delaying token rotation fixed our primary customer case. Will reopen if we see regressions. :rocket:
